news.title: The US should strongly advocate for political prisoner releases, global freedom
news.summary: While celebrating recent political prisoner releases, author Nicole Bibbins Sedaca argues that the United States must use sanctions and diplomatic pressure to challenge the systemic use of imprisonment by autocratic regimes.
